hockey_player.evidence: The right orange player has all parts visible, but the blue player lacks visible arms and a physical stick, appearing as a blue cylinder; skates are tiny slivers that vanish when downscaled.

toy.evidence: The figures use simple pill-shaped bodies, spherical floating hands, and flat shading, strongly resembling peg dolls or Fisher-Price toys.

changes: skates 0.05 of height -> 0.15 to remain visible at distance
blue player arms visibility -> add distinct arm geometry or color contrast
stick thickness 4px -> 10px to read better when downscaled
head 0.23 of height -> 0.30 for a chunkier toy proportion
worst: The blue player reads as a featureless cylinder because the arms are missing or perfectly blended into the body.
The skates are too small and thin, disappearing completely in the downscaled version.
The blue player's stick is missing, replaced by a confusing glowing white line on the ice.
works: The deep blue and warm orange colors provide excellent team contrast.
The black helmets with thick visors clearly establish the hockey theme.
The glowing puck highlight ensures the puck is easily tracked.
